doc.title: BuildingMotif Integration Specification
doc.snippet: Integrate BuildingMotif SDK to provide ASHRAE 223P semantic modeling and SHACL validation. Key principles: 223P independent, G36 depends on 223P, BuildingMotif is backend-only.

doc.title: BuildingMOTIF SDK Research
doc.snippet: BuildingMOTIF is a Python SDK (not REST API) for semantic building models using RDF graphs and ASHRAE 223P. Critical gap: requires REST API wrapper.

doc.title: BMS Supervisor Controller Architecture
doc.snippet: Python APIs own their domain. Libraries are implementation details that can be swapped. API contract stays stable even if underlying library changes.

doc.title: Coding Standards
doc.snippet: TDD approach, avoid over-engineering, fail fast, SOLID principles, YAGNI.
